notes.title: Better With A Friend turns 1 year!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone! I just wanted to take this little inevitable milestone to thank everyone for the support that Better With The Friend has received in the past year. It is great to see so many people playing it and still playing it. Getting messages from people that they finally have something to play with their kids or their girlfriend. It is really heartwarming to read those little stories being made by you guys. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="488PHS_Nsm8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]While there hasn't been an update in quite some time, I still have some things planned for Better With A Friend, but at the moment I am focussing on my other upcoming Steam Deck game: Game With Balls, that I hope to ship, before the end of the year. There is one level for this game in Better With A Friend and you can also try 5 different levels in the demo!  [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3745250/Game_With_Balls/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you all and until the next time. 

- Geert[/p]

notes.title: Game With Ball - Small Fix
notes.notes:
[p]HI! While developing Game With Balls I noticed that I wanted to do the Physics a little bit different than it was in the first version that was included in Better With A Friend so that is now roughly the same here as it is in the eventual game. 

Also fixed an issue with the timer starting too soon... Guess you will have to challenge your friends again to see who is the quickest!

Let me know what you think about the improved physics in the discussions!

And if you want more? I am working on a demo for Game With Balls that should come out fairly shortly!

Thanks everyone for playing Better With A Friend. Means a lot.  


Geert

[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3745250/"][/dynamiclink]


[/p]
